sources.title: Reasoning with Reka Flash 3
sources.evidence: Dated March 10, 2025. Announces public Flash 3 weights under Apache 2.0 and explicitly attributes function calling to the released model. Separately identifies an improved internal Nexus variant. Gives original release context as 32k.

sources.title: Reka Flash 3 model card at pinned release revision
sources.evidence: Names the model, gives nominal 21B parameters, text conversation format, Llama compatibility and reasoning tags. Describes scratch pretraining and SFT followed by RLOO. Card metadata declares apache-2.0. Nexus application capabilities are not specifications of this checkpoint.

sources.title: Flash 3 checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: LlamaForCausalLM with 44 layers, hidden size 6144, MLP width 19648, 64 query and 8 KV heads, vocabulary 100352, untied word embeddings, no attention bias, BF16, max_position_embeddings 32768 and rope_scaling null. No custom architecture or quantization configuration.

sources.title: Flash 3 tokenizer and released chat template
sources.evidence: model_max_length is 32768. Template serializes message role/content and removes previous assistant reasoning. It has no structured tools/tool_calls branch; this alone does not disprove prompt-based function calling.

sources.title: Flash 3 complete five-shard tensor index
sources.evidence: Maps 399 learned tensors across five shards; metadata total_size is 41,810,964,480 bytes. Index coverage was checked against every bounded shard header and all enabled Llama modules, not used alone as a parameter count.

sources.title: Flash 3 shard 1 bounded safetensors header
sources.evidence: HTTP 206 reads of only the 8-byte header-length prefix and 9336-byte JSON header; no tensor payload downloaded. 81 BF16 tensors, 4,894,869,504 learned elements. Every tensor name/shape matches configured modules and the index; offsets are contiguous, nonoverlapping and correctly sized.

sources.title: Official compatible Llama module implementation
sources.evidence: Reference LlamaForCausalLM constructs input embedding, 44 configured attention/MLP blocks, RMS norms and output head. Rotary inv_freq is a nonpersistent buffer. The selected causal-LM class has no MTP, modality encoder or auxiliary prediction head. Used to reconcile enabled modules, not to claim Reka pinned this library version.

sources.title: Official compatible Llama configuration defaults
sources.evidence: For omitted values, head_dim defaults to hidden_size divided by query heads (96 here) and mlp_bias defaults false. The checkpoint explicitly disables tied embeddings and attention biases.

sources.title: Current Reka Gateway Flash 3 model page
sources.evidence: Accessed current HTML. Lists hosted context as 64k, maximum output as 65,536, and chat/streaming/reasoning support. This is a current serving limit, not evidence that the March 2025 public checkpoint was trained or configured at 64k.

sources.title: Current Gateway native tool-calling support
sources.evidence: Explicitly states reka-flash-3 does not declare tools and requests containing tools return no tool_calls. This current Gateway interface restriction is distinct from the original developer claim of model function-calling capability.

sources.title: Later Flash 3.1 reinforcement-learning research
sources.evidence: July 10, 2025 post explicitly identifies original Flash 3 as a 21B reasoning model. Its subsequent training changes concern Flash 3.1; it gives no separately defined original Flash 3 active-parameter count.

sources.title: Later Reka quantization research
sources.evidence: Reviewed later primary technical material: the quantized release and experiments concern Flash 3.1, not the original Flash 3 checkpoint. Its packing/scales or storage size cannot be transferred to this BF16 release.

sources.title: Later Flash 3.1 release and application variants
sources.evidence: Distinguishes Flash 3.1, its quantized release, and customized multimodal/orchestrator application variants. These do not supply missing modality or active-parameter specifications for original Flash 3.

name.note: Official model-card title; excludes the later Flash 3.1 revision.

developer.note: Normalized display name for the releasing RekaAI organization and Reka developer site.

family.note: Lowercase catalog family for the Reka Flash model lineage.

release_date.note: Explicit original public announcement date; later repository creation/indexing dates do not replace it.

open_weights.note: Developer publicly distributes the complete five-shard checkpoint.

license.note: Canonical SPDX form supported by both card metadata and release terms. No standalone LICENSE file exists at the pinned revision; the explicit first-party grant is the basis.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete learned parameter count: 20,905,482,240, consistent with nominal 21B. All 399 BF16 tensors across all five indexed shards reconcile to the configured modules. Per layer: q/o weights [6144,6144], k/v [768,6144], gate/up [19648,6144], down [6144,19648], and two [6144] norms; 44 layers contribute 19,672,350,720. Untied input and output matrices [100352,6144] contribute 616,562,688 each, plus final norm 6,144. No missing or extra tensor names, shape mismatches, offset gaps or overlaps. Config/code disable biases and ties; no quantization scales/packing, learned position tensors, MTP or auxiliary heads are enabled. Nonpersistent rotary-frequency buffer is not a learned parameter. Count is from headers/config/code, not file-size division or nominal sibling transfer.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active-parameter count for original Flash 3 was found in the original card or checked later first-party training/comparison/quantization material. Dense execution does not justify copying complete total into a per-token active-count field; no routed-expert active convention applies.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer in Llama-compatible format: 44 blocks, grouped-query attention with 64 query/8 KV heads and head dimension 96, rotary positions, RMSNorm and gated SiLU MLPs. Every expected dense block parameter is present; no MoE router or expert modules.

context_window.note: Exact original released-checkpoint limit from both config and tokenizer. Current Gateway separately advertises 64k hosted context; it does not establish native 64k training or alter the pinned public checkpoint. No configured RoPE extension.

modalities.note: Released model accepts tokenized text and produces text. Nexus and later customized multimodal variants do not make this checkpoint multimodal.

reasoning.note: Model card identifies reasoning behavior and its reasoning delimiters/budget-forcing interface.

tool_call.note: Original developer announcement explicitly claims function calling for Flash 3 itself. This verifies claimed model capability, not native OpenAI-compatible tool_calls support: current Gateway expressly lacks that interface and the released template has no tools serialization branch. The separately improved Nexus tool-trained model is not used as evidence.

description.value: Dense text reasoning model with 20.9B parameters, pretrained from scratch and post-trained with supervised learning and reinforcement learning.
description.note: Replaces generic efficiency/extraction/automation marketing with verified architecture, approximate complete size and training information.

patch.description: Dense text reasoning model with 20.9B parameters, pretrained from scratch and post-trained with supervised learning and reinforcement learning.
patch.notes: Public checkpoint revision 8d251ecb02eca9f0f4aa052b29ef922628d2806f has 20,905,482,240 learned BF16 parameters (nominal 21B), including separate input and output embeddings; no separately defined active count is published. Its config/tokenizer context is 32,768 tokens; current Gateway advertises 64k hosted context. Function calling is an original developer claim about the model, while the current Gateway does not return native tool_calls for this identifier. Nexus and later Flash 3.1 application variants are separate.

summary: Verified Apache-2.0 and dense architecture; established exact complete 20.90548224B parameters with all five bounded headers and full module reconciliation. Corrected context to original checkpoint 32768 and tool capability to the original affirmative developer claim, preserving the distinct current Gateway 64k/no-native-tools behavior in notes. Active count remains undisclosed. Replaced unsupported generic description; verified remaining fields.
